title: Early Voting Begins Monday in District 8 Special Election
excerpt: Early voting in the special election to fill the Laredo City Council District 8 seat began Monday, Nov. 23, and runs through Tuesday, Dec. 1. Six candidates are on the ballot, and Election Day is Saturday, Dec. 5.
content:
Early voting in the special election to fill the Laredo City Council District 8 seat began Monday, Nov. 23, and runs through Tuesday, Dec. 1.

The seat has been vacant since Alyssa Cigarroa resigned in September to run for mayor. Six candidates are on the ballot, in ballot order: Maria Irma Lopez, Jose Luis Maldonado, Jose Sergio Dorantes, Oscar Eric Ramirez, Priscilla Trevino and Mario Alberto Trevino, according to KGNS.

Early voting is open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23, through Wednesday, Nov. 25. Polls are closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, for Thanksgiving. Early voting resumes Saturday, Nov. 28, from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; Sunday, Nov. 29, from noon to 6 p.m.; and Monday, Nov. 30, and Tuesday, Dec. 1, from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Early voting sites are the Webb County Elections Office, 720 Convent Ave.; Lamar Bruni Vergara Inner City Park, 202 W. Plum St.; Laredo Fire Department Station No. 1, 1 Guadalupe St.; and Gallagher Garden Apartments, 5118 Gallagher Ave.

Election Day is Saturday, Dec. 5, with polls open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., according to the City of Laredo.

Update — November 24, 2026: An earlier version of this story listed the wrong candidates, polling places, hours and Election Day. The story has been corrected with the official information. Nearly 260 ballots were cast on the first day of early voting Monday, according to KGNS — 185 people voted in person and just over 70 mail-in ballots were received. The Webb County Elections Office had the highest turnout, according to KGNS.

Sources: City of Laredo Resolution 2026-R-205; KGNS, Nov. 22, 2026. Nov. 24 update source: KGNS, Nov. 24, 2026.
